lines.text: David calls the one who cares for the poor blessed, and the LORD will deliver him in trouble.
The LORD will sustain the sick in bed, and David asks to be healed because he has sinned.
David's enemies ask when he will die, and his visitor spreads slander while all who hate him whisper.
David's close friend who shared his bread lifted his hand against him, so David asks to be raised up.
The LORD delights in David, upholds him in integrity, and sets him in His presence for many years.
